literal_meaning: দল গঠনের দলাদলি (group formation's intrigue or factionalism)
figurative_meaning_en: Opposition or resistance by forming groups or factions
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাজনীতিতে দলাদলি করে সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে পরাজিত করল।
গ্রামে দলাদলির ফলে ঝগড়া বেড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: In politics, he defeated his rival through factional maneuvering.
Factionalism in the village has led to increased quarrels.
note: This idiom reflects common social and political dynamics in Bengali-speaking regions.
